Paper accepted for gis.SCIENCE

The Paper „Concepts for Automatic Generalization of Virtual 3D Landscape Models“ by Tassilo Glander, Matthias Trapp, and Jürgen Döllner, has been accepted by gis.SCIENCE, the scientific professional journal in geoinformatics in Germany. The article will be published in the journal’s first issue 2012 and also contributes to its cover page.
